item.tib: gab sbas gsang ba shams bu
item.coloph: ces pa zhu ston g.yung drung nyi rgyal la/ rig 'dzin dgongs rgyud byung bzhin du/ dbra btsun shes rgyal bdag la'o/ mkha' 'gro'i snyan rgyud byung bzhin sug bris byed/ nyes 'gal thams cad skyabs gnas spyan sngar bshags/ dge rtsa gang mchis mkha' mnyam 'gro la bsngo/ bstan dang bstan 'dzin dpon slob gong 'phel zhing / rdul bzhin 'phel zhing yun gnas bkra shis shog gsang rgya khrom du bshad pa rung min kyang / lha grogs thugs dgongs mnyes phyir phral (du) phul//
